parts:
Angela:

One part of your project will require understanding of deposition and=20
decomposition rates for your study species: you can consult

Chapman, N.G.
Faecal pellets of Reeves' muntjac, Muntiacus reevesi: Defecation rate, de=
composition period, size and weight
(2004) European Journal of Wildlife Research, 50 (3), pp. 141-145.

for information about how to acquire that information. I can't speak to=20
animal movement simulation approaches; there are undoubtedly many. =20
For the survey design simulations, I encourage you to investigate WiSP,=20
which can perform some basic line transect survey simulations.

http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/estimating.abundance/WiSP/index.html
